title: MI60007: Geomatics And Remote Sensing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Real property boundary determination, aerial and digital mapping, Geodesy and
geodetic surveying, GPS, Basics of photgrammetry. Introduction to remote
sensing: sensors, present status of remote sensing satellites, Digital image
processing techniques; introduction to digital terrain modelling; Environmental
resource mapping, Geomatics application programming. Introduction to Land and
Geographic Information Systems; Different coordinate system, working principle
of GIS, Database associated with GIS, Applications of GIS in surface mining,
Applications of GIS in land development, road construction, etc,. Hands on
exercise on Image processing and GIS packages
